step1.description:
What happens when you benchmark 90+ frameworks?  Why is the Virtual DOM officially losing the war to Signals? Why was SolidJS doing "React Hooks" before React even announced them?

In this Podcast with Ryan Carniato:
🟡 Discover how to eliminate the "butterfly effect" and state chaos in large-scale applications
🟡 Get the mechanical proof of why components should only run once for peak DOM performance
🟡 Learn the mental shift from "writes" to "reads" that makes SolidJS inherently faster than React
🟡 See how Ryan applies fine-grained reactivity to solve real-world bottlenecks in massive production apps
🟡 Explore the roadmap for the next evolution of frameworks and what comes after the current reactivity hype

Learn more about Ryan: https://dev.to/ryansolid
Learn more about SolidJS: https://www.solidjs.com/
